profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR with CIK 0001828108. Its website presents it as a developer of self-driving freight technology built around the Aurora Driver, which the company describes as combining hardware and software backed by verifiable AI and as integrating autonomy into existing fleets. The site frames the work as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site's quoted testimonials describe pilot programs and partnerships. One quote references autonomously hauling freight between Fort Worth and El Paso and a hybrid model combining professional drivers with the Aurora Driver. Another says the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous, and a third refers to the performance of the self-driving system over millions of autonomous miles and to CDL drivers.

Held records list no lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company. Litigation exposure is recorded for Pennsylvania, with a count of 172.
